title: United Trust Bank launches targeted PBSA lending solutions
summary: United Trust Bank (UTB) has launched a new range of purpose-built student accommodation (PBSA) lending solutions to support developers in key university locations across England and Wales. The financing is aimed at experienced developers and covers new-build schemes, conversions and refurbishments for student accommodation.

content: United Trust Bank (UTB) has launched a new range of purpose-built student accommodation (PBSA) lending solutions to support developers in key university locations across England and Wales. The financing is aimed at experienced developers and covers new-build schemes, conversions and refurbishments for student accommodation, with Loan facilities ranging from £7.5m to £35m.
